inputs.description: Original direct-magnetometer epochs are the decoder features. Original run/trial/shape/rotation/scaling/miniblock metadata serve identity joins, source selection, fold scheduling and shape-specific evaluation only; they are not extra prediction covariates unless exact original source use is separately established. Reference=1 and outlier=0; scores increase toward reference without post-hoc inversion. Exclude first six miniblock trials using early/late metadata assigned before Epochs.selection and retain complete lineage. Held-run reference/outlier conditions, event codes or metadata encoding those labels remain evaluator-only; candidates receive only source-permitted training-fold labels and necessary opaque row/split identities. Source-fold isolation across reused directional folds is required. Exact prepared-input identity and exposure boundaries remain unresolved.

preprocessing.description: Preserve source bad-channel/Maxwell/SSS,0.1-40Hz filtering,250Hz resampling,SSP/autoreject and retained epochs. Cached shared decoder uses direct magnetometers, training-fold StandardScaler and liblinear logistic regression on unsmoothed epochs. Commented uniform_filter1d25 does not authenticate the published smoothed branch. Source -0.1..1.1s conflicts with -0.15..1.15s paper description and fold scaling with stated epoch normalization. Resolve before original-author comparison; do not silently choose a branch or grid.

metric.description: Shape/time ROC AUROC for reference-positive scores, using average ranks for ties; preserve below-chance values. Undefined single-class cells are not filled with chance. Original decoder fits jointly over shapes and evaluates each shape separately. Full support is20x6x11x301 code-axis cells per branch, with final-paper axis equivalence unresolved. Higher matched-source AUROC is ordered predictive improvement; regularity correlations, p-values and peak timing are separate biological summaries.

aggregation.description: Compute AUROC independently per participant/fold/shape/time, arithmetic mean across six folds, then equal mean across twenty participants; never pool overlapping-fold predictions or weight by trial count. Preserve both smoothing branches and all curves/class counts. Source plotting additionally averages over a union of significant positive regularity clusters; its authentic fixed union, numeric baseline and a defensible complete-support improvement decision remain unresolved. One source display SEM uses sqrt(19) despite twenty people; preserve and report rather than silently changing it or using it as independent uncertainty.
